eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Spokane, WA; at 9:00 AM on AUG 1, 2026 Effective until 12:00 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: The National Weather Service has issued a Particularly Dangerous Situation (PDS) Red Flag Warning for Spokane County for Saturday, August 1 from 2 PM to 8 PM. Wind gusts could reach 40-50 miles per hour. This means that new fires will grow rapidly and aggressively. Be alert for new fire starts and be prepared to evacuate immediately if a wildfire breaks out. Have multiple ways to monitor instructions and receive information.
